observed_environment_limits: Gunicorn & multi-session ceiling: isolated benchmark runs `GUNICORN_WORKERS=4, GUNICORN_THREADS=4` (16 concurrent Python threads) with dedicated `queue-short` + `queue-long`. Across 20, 40, and 80 simultaneous zero-think-time user sessions, 20 and 40 sessions stay comfortably sub-second; at 80 simultaneous active requests queueing behind 16 Gunicorn threads increases tail `p95`/`p99` cleanly with 0% 5xx.

Full monthly KPI recompute (`75,000` Work Items / `250,000` Attempts / `150,000` SLA Obligations) completes in `33571.48 ms` (daily incremental: `2953.42 ms`) on `queue-long` without blocking UI snapshot reads and publishes the new revision atomically only upon completion.

Paginated KPI drill-down after SQL interval aggregation & lazy business-minute optimizations achieves `p95=290.296 ms` on daily campaign scope and `p95=203.35 ms` on full-month company `250k`-attempt scope (`<= 3,000 ms`).

Bulk batch operations on dedicated `queue-long`: `50,000`-row CSV import completes in `144339.37 ms`; `10,000`-Work-Item weighted distribution preview completes in `787.08 ms` (`<= 60,000 ms`) and chunked background execution completes in `764511.65 ms` with `0` duplicates and unblocked interactive `My Customers` reads.

proposed_slos_for_review.target_sizing_assumption: 4 vCPU / 8-16 GB RAM isolated host, Gunicorn 4 workers x 4 threads, dedicated queue-short + queue-long
